event.description: Come and share the joy of Art Links with us! Art Links is a social support program that promotes engagement for individuals diagnosed with Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias or seniors at risk of isolation and depression. By using a variety of creative art ideas, we promote self-expression as well as socialization and meaningful connections. Participants enjoy: A variety of artistic mediums Music and movement Memory-rich conversations Facilitated by ARA staff and local artists. Free to attend! No registration required. Share with friends and family. For more information, contact Debbie Chulick at dchulick@alzalaska.org.

event.title: “One Voice, Many Lifetimes” Concert
event.venue_json: {"id":10629,"global_id":"www.alzalaska.org?id=10629","venue":"Alaska Performing Art Center, Discovery Theater","address":"621 West 6th Avenue","city":"Anchorage","province":"AK","zip":"99501","url":"https://www.alzalaska.org/venue/alaska-performing-art-center-discovery-theater/","show_map":true,"show_map_link":true}
event.description: Experience an extraordinary intergenerational concert unlike any other. One Voice, One Lifetime brings together the voices of elementary, middle, and High School students alongside Alaskans living with Alzheimer’s in a moving celebration of music, memory, and community. This rare performance transcends cultural, generational, socioeconomic, and religious differences, reminding us that music has the power to unite us all. Through familiar favorites and inspiring new songs, these voices will share a message of hope, connection, and belonging—demonstrating that while memories may fade, the gift of music continues to bring us together. Alzheimer’s Resource Alaska is proud to collaborate with Keys to Life Alaska for the “One Voice, Many Lifetimes” Concert on Sunday, October 18, 2026, from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM at the Alaska Performing Arts Center, Discovery Theater in Anchorage. This special evening will bring community together through music, reflection, and shared experience. Tickets will be available starting September 15. Buy Tickets Today: One Voice, Many Lifetimes :: CenterTix

event.title: Dementia Live – Anchorage
event.description: Experience dementia from a new perspective in just 30 minutes. Dementia Live® is a free, immersive simulation that helps participants better understand the sensory and cognitive challenges of living with dementia while building empathy and compassion. Led by a certified Dementia Live® Coach, participants also learn practical strategies for providing more supportive, person centered care. Who should attend? Family caregivers Healthcare and care professionals First responders Community organizations and businesses Anyone wanting to better understand dementia Dementia Live is NOT recommended for a person living with brain change. Register Your 30 Minute Spot Today!
